name: Kairos
description: Kairos is a structured psychedelic compound engineered to interface with BCI architecture, using the neural implant as a scaffold to organize hallucinations into coherent, navigable experiences rather than chaotic visuals. The drug generates what users call 'guided trips' — mythological journeys, architectural dreamscapes, encounters with AI-generated figures that feel numinous and real. Sober users describe it as the closest thing to religious experience available commercially.
effects: BCI-synchronized structured hallucinations — coherent, navigable, deeply meaningful
Ego dissolution paired with sense of cosmic connection
Perception of profound personal insight and revelation
Time dilation — hours feel like lifetimes of experience
Residual sense of peace and clarity lasting days after use
side_effects: Hallucinogen persisting perception disorder in frequent users
BCI destabilization — neural interface may require recalibration post-dose
The revelations feel real but are chemically generated — users may make major life decisions based on hallucinatory insight
Without BCI, pirated Kairos produces unstructured, terrifying hallucinations
Rare: users become unable to distinguish between BCI-generated and external reality — permanent perceptual confusion
street_price: Φ95 licensed; Φ35 pirated (no BCI scaffolding)
cultural_context: Kairos has generated its own religion — the Kairosi, a movement of people who believe the drug provides genuine access to transcendent truth, and that the BCI is not scaffolding but a receiver picking up signals that were always there. Helix Biosystems has quietly funded academic papers questioning this interpretation while watching the movement grow their market. The pirated version, called 'raw Kairos,' has caused multiple psychotic breaks on the Shelf, where users have BCIs too degraded to scaffold the experience properly.
story_hooks: A Kairosi leader has experienced a hallucination so specific — coordinates, a face, a piece of information — that it turned out to be real, and now everyone wants to know if someone is using the drug's BCI integration to transmit actual data through the trip

Raw Kairos on the Shelf is getting stronger, not weaker — the pirated formula has been modified by someone who wants the hallucinations uncontrolled and terrifying, and Shelf residents are experiencing coordinated nightmare imagery
